description: This file defines a class AppDatabase that provides a local database interface using the sqflite package. It manages an 'attendance_queue' table to store and synchronize attendance records, with methods for initialization, insertion, querying pending records, marking records as synchronized, and clearing all records.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: A singleton class providing database access and management for attendance records, encapsulating CRUD operations on the 'attendance_queue' table.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database, creating the attendance_queue table if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Inserts or replaces an attendance record into the queue.

methods.name: pending
methods.description: Retrieves all attendance records that are pending synchronization (where 'synced' is 0).

methods.name: markSynced
methods.description: Marks a specific record as synchronized by setting 'synced' to 1.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Deletes all records from the attendance_queue table.
